checks.criterion: Value monetization through TRCC, joint ventures, and development
checks.evidence: Commercial/industrial real estate revenue increased $4.6 million to $9.7 million from $5.1 million; management said it will continue commercial and industrial development directly and through joint ventures, including opportunistic land sales.

checks.criterion: Cost discipline and growth in recurring segments
checks.evidence: The summary states results benefited from lower corporate expenses, while mineral resources revenue increased 20% to $1.8 million and farming revenue increased to $0.8 million. The reported KPIs do not provide the corporate-expense amount or multifamily results needed to verify the thesis benchmark.

checks.criterion: TRCC industrial JV portfolio remains fully leased and Building 1B delivery remains on track
checks.evidence: No current-quarter TRCC occupancy, portfolio square footage, or Building 1B delivery update was provided.

checks.criterion: Centennial re-entitlement before the LA County Board of Supervisors
checks.evidence: The reported KPIs and guidance contain no LA County hearing, re-entitlement, or RPDEIR update.

checks.criterion: Centennial re-entitlement fails at the LA County Board of Supervisors, or new CEQA litigation is filed and an injunction is granted
checks.evidence: No Board of Supervisors decision, CEQA litigation filing, or injunction was reported.
No Terra Vista leasing or occupancy KPI was provided.
No current TRCC industrial occupancy KPI was provided.

checks.criterion: Corporate expenses re-inflate above the 2025 run-rate excluding one-offs
checks.evidence: The summary says results benefited from lower corporate expenses, but no current corporate-expense figure or adjusted 2025 run-rate was provided.

checks.criterion: Two consecutive quarters where net income is positive only because of non-recurring land or water sales
checks.evidence: Net income attributable to common stockholders was positive at $2.6 million versus a $1.7 million loss, but this is only one quarter and the report does not quantify the contribution of land or water sales. Management cautioned that net income fluctuates with land-sale timing, leasing activity, and commodity prices.

data.summary: Reported revenue, Adjusted EBITDA, and profitability improved, supporting the monetization pillar and recurring mineral and farming growth. The key operational and entitlement kill tests were not disclosed, and the positive quarter does not establish or rule out dependence on non-recurring land or water sales.
